title: Arthur C. Clarke says NASA found large life on Mars, with Buzz Aldrin present

tellings.quote:
what's really shocking and exciting to
me is that uh NASA has basically
discovered large forms of life on Mars.

plain: A researcher guest on Jesse Michels's podcast says that around 2000 the science fiction writer Arthur C. Clarke, with the astronaut Buzz Aldrin present, said that NASA, the US space agency, had "basically discovered large forms of life on Mars." The guest passes this on as something Clarke said, because if true it would mean NASA was holding back proof of life on another planet.
